scope: Read-only hosted development global active catalog export; no live/source edits.
method: All 715 names, modes and fields manually screened; 150 primary Catalyst source descriptions retrieved for candidate/contrast verification. No claim that all 715 movement descriptions were independently verified. Exact ID proposals avoid broad title/category regex changes.
rpe_policy: RPE kept where already present; this audit does not propose compulsory RPE on every exercise. RPE can be an optional effort control globally. Duration-only mobility rows preserve absence of RPE when changed to reps.

implementation_notes: Do not modify completed session snapshots.
Do not silently overwrite explicit planned-workout fields or intervals; defaults apply when adding new movements unless provenance says they were inherited.
Do not regex-migrate every occurrence of plank/hold/dip/sled or every Core/Mobility/Jumping category.
Keep load optional for bodyweight/bands; loaded variants and athlete intent remain valid.
These are measurement metadata recommendations, not exercise technique, medical or training prescriptions.
